integrity: All new finite counts are reproduced by separate BFS/C++ and Floyd-Warshall/Python implementations; n=10 orbits are checked by a third standalone program. All public claims have been reviewed against definitions; no external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The new finite proof exhausts exactly 3<=n<=12; the infinite tail uses the stated n>=13 theorem of Iqbal et al. Exact count of higher-order edge bases and full automorphism-group classification are not claimed. Publication priority is provisional.
title: Sharp ten-cycle onset and all small edge-metric bases of double generalized Petersen graphs
